rtl_proposals.title: Pipeline or restructure the worst cone
rtl_proposals.detail: Worst path _696_/Q -> resp_msg[15] has 14 cell stages (0.371 ns of cell delay). If physical edits cannot recover 35 ps, split this cone with a register (adds one cycle of latency) or rebalance it in RTL. Must re-pass Forge's gate (sim vs. integer model). (This design config has no RTL, only a netlist, so this stays a proposal.)

script_diff:
--- baseline/place.tcl
+++ final/place.tcl
@@ -52,3 +52,3 @@
 global_placement -routability_driven -density 0.3 -pad_left 2 -pad_right 2
-place_pins -hor_layers metal3 -ver_layers metal2
+place_pins -hor_layers metal3 -ver_layers metal2 -annealing
 estimate_parasitics -placement
--- baseline/cts.tcl
+++ final/cts.tcl
@@ -51,3 +51,3 @@
 repair_clock_inverters
-clock_tree_synthesis -root_buf BUF_X4 -buf_list BUF_X4 -sink_clustering_enable -sink_clustering_max_diameter 100
+clock_tree_synthesis -root_buf BUF_X8 -buf_list BUF_X8 -sink_clustering_enable -sink_clustering_max_diameter 100
 repair_clock_nets
@@ -57,3 +57,3 @@
 estimate_parasitics -placement
-repair_timing -skip_gate_cloning
+repair_timing -setup_margin 0.0727
 detailed_placement
--- baseline/grt.tcl
+++ final/grt.tcl
@@ -54,2 +54,8 @@
 estimate_parasitics -global_routing
+global_route -start_incremental
+repair_timing -setup_margin 0.0470
+set_placement_padding -global -left 1 -right 1
+detailed_placement
+global_route -end_incremental -congestion_report_file {<run>/grt/congestion_eco.rpt}
+estimate_parasitics -global_routing
 pa_timing_metrics grt
